appearance_lead: How Lodestar looks on your devices. Changes apply at once and follow your account.
appearance_load_failed: Couldn't load your appearance settings. Reload to try again.
appearance_save_failed: Couldn't save that change. Your last saved setting is back.
appearance_theme_help: Pick a colour theme and whether it follows your system.
appearance_picker_failed: Couldn't load the themes. Check your connection and try again.
appearance_motion_help: System follows your device's reduced-motion setting.
appearance_illustrations_help: Pictures in empty and first-run screens. They are off automatically in low-resource mode.
appearance_adult_help: Off by default. This applies to the whole server, not only to you.
appearance_dark_other: Use a different theme in dark mode
appearance_locked: Set by the server and can't be changed here: {fields}.
appearance_picker_data_failed: Couldn't load the themes. Check your connection and try again.
appearance_editor_invalid: Enter every colour as a six-digit hex value, like #527F91, to see the report.
appearance_editor_cvd: Colour separation: {normal} for typical vision, {deuteranopia} for deuteranopia and {protanopia} for protanopia. Higher is easier to tell apart; colour is never the only cue.
appearance_editor_weak: {count} checks fail. Some text or marks may be hard to read. Use it anyway only if you accept that.
appearance_editor_json_help: Themes are saved in this browser only. Export one as JSON to move it to another browser, then import it there.
appearance_editor_failed: Couldn't load the editor. Try again.
appearance_custom_missing: This account uses a custom theme that isn't in this browser, so Riverstone is shown. Custom themes are kept per browser; export and import moves one.
appearance_adult_locked: Set by the environment variable {variable}, so it can't be changed here.
appearance_editor_import_failed: That isn't a valid theme file. Export one from here to see the format.
